description: Measured Vitest v8 coverage floor for apps/dsa-web/src. Floor is floor(measured_percent - epsilon_percent). Do not lower thresholds to hide regressions; raise them only after a clean remasurement on origin/main-equivalent unit tests.

excludeReasons.src/types/api.generated.ts: Generated OpenAPI TypeScript snapshot; not hand-written runtime logic.
excludeReasons.src/dev/**: Local/dev mocks and annotator stubs, not production runtime.
excludeReasons.src/playground/**: Developer playground catalog and fixtures, not shipped product routes.
excludeReasons.src/locales/**: Translation dictionaries; structure is gated by i18n tests, not unit coverage.
excludeReasons.src/i18n/translations/**: Generated locale resource bundles from i18n:resources.
excludeReasons.src/assets/**: Static SVG/image assets with no executable logic.
excludeReasons.src/**/__tests__/**: Unit-test files and helpers; coverage measures production source.
excludeReasons.src/test-utils/**: Test harness helpers, not production runtime.
excludeReasons.src/setupTests.ts: Vitest setup file, not production runtime.
